blocks.x: Who were your favorite clarinet players? Anyone in particular that you can remember that you liked when you were young or you played with?
Well, I used to like to hear Willard Turner, Tuma at least.
What's the name again? Tuma, Will Tuma. Will.
Oh yes. I knew him. Tats they called him.
